Class SshClientApp.UserFrameListener

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.SshClientApp.UserFrameListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
AmwpClientListener
Enclosing class:
SshClientApp
private final class SshClientApp.UserFrameListener extends Object implements AmwpClientListener
The UserFrameListener receives AMWP frames for one SSH user. Frames are accepted under the stored username. Console thought is offered to the pane that owns the connector.

  • Method Details

    • onAmwpFrame

      public void onAmwpFrame(AmwpFrame frame)
      The onAmwpFrame method accepts one frame. The notebook accepts the frame under the stored username. A frame with no thought text and no end marker returns immediately. Any other frame updates the console thought on the Swing thread.
      Specified by:
      onAmwpFrame in interface AmwpClientListener
      Parameters:
      frame - The AMWP frame.

    • onAmwpClosed

      public void onAmwpClosed(String reason)
      The onAmwpClosed method drops this connector. The connector is removed from the aimed set. The notebook is told that the session closed.
      Specified by:
      onAmwpClosed in interface AmwpClientListener
      Parameters:
      reason - The close reason.
